description: Searches the transcripts the user made in the last day for passages and repeated themes. Best for: "where did I talk about pricing", "which hooks did I open with", "what themes keep coming up". Returns: passages with transcript_id, start and end in seconds, a clock time and a snippet; repeated themes with counts; and the live transcripts. Input tips: pass query for passages; leave it out to list the transcripts and their themes. Pass library_id when transcribe_media returned one. Only the caller's own transcripts are searched (the latest 10, kept 24 hours). Not for: transcribing a file (use transcribe_media) or searching the web.

library_id.description: The library_id an earlier transcribe_media answer returned, such as lib_9b6a98861ea4f54bff8f5cf1. It names the set of transcripts that call saved. Pass it when that answer had one; leave it out when it was null or absent.

query.description: Words or a phrase to look for, such as a topic or a hook. Leave out to list the transcripts and their repeated themes only.

name: search_transcripts

as_of.description: The UTC day of the answer, such as 2026-10-10.

at.description: The time as a clock, such as 0:34 or 1:02:05.

end.description: End, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

matched_terms.description: Query words found in the passage.

start.description: Start, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

transcript_id.description: Id of a saved transcript, for suggest_clips and translate_subtitles.

query.description: The query searched; null when only listing.

status.description: ok: the caller has live transcripts. empty: none are left (never made, deleted after 24 hours, or library_id missing); notes says what to do. A refused call returns no object, only an error text such as "transcript_not_found: ..." that says what to do next.

at.description: The time as a clock, such as 0:34 or 1:02:05.

start.description: Start, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

transcript_id.description: Id of a saved transcript, for suggest_clips and translate_subtitles.

mentions.description: Times the word is said in all transcripts.

term.description: A word repeated across the transcripts.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the recording, in whole seconds.

expires_at.description: When the transcript is deleted, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

transcript_id.description: Id of a saved transcript, for suggest_clips and translate_subtitles.

title: Search your saved transcripts
